result.title: RecallGS: Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent's observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian's rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RecallGS，一种免训练的在线语义 3DGS 机制：把历史观测当作非参数几何—语义先验，经 CLIP 检索、alpha 合成权重筛选几何支持的视角，再聚合其语义特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用检索与几何支持度从观测历史中挑证据、而非另训网络」的做法，可能与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选相关，可供核查该思路能否迁移到推理期的证据获取；但论文本身不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent 状态。
